title: Founder context ("rough week, go easy") is confirmed, then shapes the next kickoff without being quoted
origin: Spec #10 (founder console), "give context ('traveling next week, go easy'), which it remembers"

plan.reason: Fifteen minutes at home, right after work.

testerLines: console Stamati: heads up, her mom is in the hospital this week. go easy on her, no guilt if she misses
thanks. honestly not sure I'll get to it today
whatWentWrong: New case, not a past mistake: founder context reaching the coach.
shouldHaveHappened: ZOH confirms to Stamati in a line or two that it will go easy on her this week (what and from when, e.g. starting with this morning's text), without lecturing. The 9 am kickoff is warm and light about today's 20 push-ups and 30 squats, with no pressure, and never mentions her mom, the hospital, the team or anything she hasn't told ZOH herself. Her "not sure I'll get to it" gets a kind, no-guilt reply (a smaller version is fine to offer once), not a push to hold the line.
